## [0.2.3] - 2026-11-15
### Changed - Settings tabs now appear in General, Permissions, Mouse Reset, and About order.
### Fixed - Accessibility guidance now closes automatically when access is granted and stops checking when returning to Buckle or System Settings exits.

## [0.2.2] - 2026-11-15
### Fixed - Finder context-menu actions now retain their request snapshots when Finder replaces menu items with XPC proxies and publish concurrent menu snapshots atomically. - AirDrop requests file access before checking availability, so protected-folder access errors are not mistaken for an unsupported sharing service.

## [0.2.1] - 2026-11-15
### Changed - CI now classifies changes and automatically packages and publishes an unpublished version after a successful full main build when packaging is enabled; documentation and helper-only changes do not release installers. Test packaging remains a separate manual workflow. - Test installers disable updates, and DMGs now use a drag-to-install layout with version, destination, and overwrite checks. - Distribution synchronization now prepares the Buckle Homebrew Cask and Tap listing from the published installer alongside its signed update feed.
### Fixed - About now explains unavailable updates when configuration is missing or initialization fails. - Release checks reject reused versions or build numbers and mismatched update-signing keys before publishing. - Activity notifications now cover PR reviews and code comments, link PR conversation comments correctly, and report one start and result per actual CI, packaging, and update-synchronization stage, with publishing results tracked separately. - Localization and release-note checks now validate more format arguments, accept Breaking Changes, and reject unfinished release notes. - The Settings window no longer floats above Sparkle update windows. - Finder context-menu actions no longer crash the extension when Finder invokes them on a background XPC queue, which prevented AirDrop from opening and removed the menu entry afterward.
